author: NETWORG
name: Power Platform: Tab Footer
description: Injects a <tabfooter> XML element into a Dataverse dialog form tab. Use when you need a footer area at the bottom of a dialog tab.

SolutionRootPath.description: Relative path from the project folder (.csproj) to the folder containing unpacked Dataverse solution files (Other/, Entities/, OptionSets/). Use '.' if solution files are directly in the project folder, or a subfolder name like 'Declarations'. Do not use 'Entities' or 'Other' — those are subdirectories inside the solution metadata root.

FormId.description: GUID of the specific form where the tab footer will be added

TabId.description: GUID of the specific tab where the footer will be added

TabIndex.description: Index number of the tab (1-based) where the footer will be added

TabFooterId.description: Unique identifier for the tab footer (automatically generated GUID)

manualInstructions.text: Applying the dialog tab footer scaffold via 'txc workspace component apply-scaffold'

postActions.description: Applying the dialog tab footer scaffold via the TALXIS CLI
